name: PARDUS Robin EVO competition build
why_interesting: An exact-model 6.2 kg competition build shows the Robin EVO's lightweight potential, and official product pages provide a factory reference without conflating the builds.
missing: Map the competition post to the official 750 g generation or the newer Robin EVO platform
Current mainland price, current-generation stock BOM and stock state
Manufacturer maximum tire clearance for the exact competition-build generation
Current warranty terms and confirm that the official purchase route is active

facts.drivetrain: Custom build: Shimano Dura-Ace R9270 with 10-36 cassette
facts.frame_material: Generation conflict: the 2024 third-generation official frame uses UHMS-EPS+ carbon with T1100 and M40 reinforcement, while older official material reports a different approximately 750 g generation; the competition build is not mapped to either
facts.frame_construction: The 2024 third-generation platform uses full hidden routing and a dedicated fork/cockpit, but those details are not transferred to the unresolved competition build
facts.complete_weight_basis: Exact public XS competition-build report claims 6.2 kg; generation mapping, scale protocol and full configuration remain unpublished. The current official standard page gives frame/fork/cockpit weights only and does not map the custom build to a generation or state its complete-build weighing basis.
facts.frame_stiffness_status: No generation-safe controlled or sufficiently specific independent stiffness result found after 50 registered source areas
facts.support_route: PARDUS China customer-service contact page and dealer locator; exact-generation warranty duration and claim eligibility remain unverified
facts.current_factory_price_reference: The current China ROBIN EVO Ultegra Di2 page has a price label but no visible numeric amount. Current indexed numerical results refer to older rim-brake trims or foreign-market material and do not identify the XS Dura-Ace competition build.

source_note:
The exact public XS competition build reports 6.2 kg, but remains unmapped between incompatible official generations. No generation-safe stiffness result was established after 50 areas. Current official pages still provide no exact-build mainland price or manufacturer maximum tire clearance. The 2026-09-23 standard Ultegra Di2 page lists a 750 g size-M frame, 290 g fork and 295 g cockpit plus buy/store-search links, but no complete-bike weight or mapping to the custom build. Support-route review on 2026-09-22 confirms manufacturer contact and dealer routes only; it does not establish custom-build stock or warranty coverage.

Batch 65 recheck (2026-09-25): the exact 2024 Robin EVO page confirms UHMS-EPS+ with T1100/M40 reinforcement and 710 g at size M, but the XS custom Dura-Ace build remains unmapped to that generation. The separate Ultegra Di2 route timed out; no grade is transferred.
price_status: No current mainland numeric price is published for the exact XS Dura-Ace competition build. Historical or foreign prices do not map to this build.
